Bay Area Corporate DJ & Event Emcee Services

Elevate your next corporate gathering with the Bay Area’s best DJ and Emcee services. At Chris Webb Entertainment, we specialize in bringing company events to life with high-energy music, professional hosting, and seamless event flow.

25 Years of Excellence in Northern California

For over 25 years, we have been a trusted partner for the Bay Area’s premier Convention Centers, Conference Centers, and Trade Shows. We are proud to be featured on the exclusive referral lists of top local venues and corporations, proving our reliability and status as a preferred vendor.

Here are Just a Few of our many Clients:

Leading the Future of Event Entertainment

We stay at the cutting edge of industry trends. Most recently, our team performed at high-profile venues including:

  • Santa Clara Convention Center

  • San Francisco Moscone Center (2026 AI & Cybersecurity Conferences)

Whether you are planning a massive Convention, a high-tech Trade Show, or a more intimate, socially distant micro-gathering, we provide the professional audio and entertainment coverage you need.

Tailored Services for Every Event

  • Employee Parties & Team Building: Boost morale with a “party-rocking” atmosphere.

  • Non-Profit & Charity Events: We proudly offer special discounts for Non-Profit Rallies, Charities, and Fundraisers to support our community.

  • Corporate Holiday Parties: Secure your date early for the best experience.

Exclusive 2026 Promotional Specials

Bay Area World Cup DJ Watch Party 2026 Santa Clara Comvention Center.

Maximize your budget with our current event packages. Choose from two special offers:

  1. The Multi-Booking Discount: Book your Holiday Party now and receive a tiered discount on every package deal—the more you book, the more you save!

  2. Premium Event Enhancements: Upgrade your event with your choice of:

    • 10 Custom Giveaways: Including high-energy LED batons for the dance floor.

    • 18 Professional LED Uplights: Wireless Lighting for your venue with cinematic color.

    • Premium Photo Booth Package: Custom deals to capture every memory.

Why Choose Our Bay Area Company DJ?

We don’t just play music; we provide a full-service entertainment experience. From the Moscone Center to local office parties, our personal touch ensures your guests stay engaged and your event runs perfectly.

[Click Here to Contact Us & Claim Your Special Offer]

Superbowl Levi Stadium 2016 DJ.

Google DJ in Mountain View

Trusted by the Best: Our Bay Area Corporate Clients

Chris Webb Entertainment is proud to be the preferred entertainment provider for some of the most prestigious organizations in San Francisco, Silicon Valley, and across Northern California. Our track record of excellence spans Fortune 500 tech giants, professional sports franchises, and government agencies. Join our growing list of satisfied partners:

Technology & Innovation Leaders

  • Nvidia | Google | Apple | Facebook (Meta) | Adobe

  • Cisco | eBay | Yahoo | Genentech

  • HP (Hewlett Packard) | Sun Microsystems | Symantec

  • McAfee | Nextel | Novell | Dictionary.com | Coupons.com

Finance & Professional Services

  • Visa | American Express | Wells Fargo | Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco | Chase

  • Agile | Winston Law Offices | RE/MAX | Farmers Insurance

  • Money Marketing | Dorado | 7-Eleven

Premier Venues & Sports Organizations

  • San Francisco 49ers (Levi’s Stadium)

  • Golden State Warriors (Chase Center San Francisco Events)
  • SF GIANTS (Oracle Park)

  • Manchester United (Levi’s Stadium Events)

  • USA Polo Team (Mexico, Great Britain Polo Teams)

  • Almaden Golf & Country Club

  • InterContinental Hotels | Personality Hotels

  • San Jose Chamber of Commerce

Education & Healthcare Institutions

  • Stanford University Medical Center

  • UC Cal Berkeley Haas School of Business

  • Santa Clara University | San Francisco State University

  • Kaiser Permanente | Adobe Hospital

Government & Public Service

  • United States Coast Guard | United States Air Force (USAF)

  • SFPD (San Francisco Police Department)

  • San Francisco Fire Department

  • Tahoe Police Department

Retail & Industry Giants

  • Chevron | Coca-Cola | Virgin Airlines

  • IKEA | Home Depot | Sealy Mattress | Sleep Train | Mattress Discounters

More

DJ For San Francisco 49ers at Levi Stadium September DJ & Photo Booth

Comprehensive AV, Meetings & Speaker Rentals

We provide more than just music; we are your partner in Corporate AV & Meetings. Our professional Speaker Rentals and AV Rental packages ensure crystal-clear sound for every presentation, from intimate boardrooms to massive conventions at the Moscone Center or Santa Clara Convention Center.

Interactive Entertainment & High-Tech Enhancements

Transform your employee party or trade show with our premium activation services:

  • 360 Photo Booth Experience: Capturing every angle of the fun for social-ready content.

  • Karaoke & Karaoke Rentals: Professional KJ services and high-end Karaoke rental setups for team building and office parties. With Option for Silent Disco at the After Party

  • Cold Sparkler Displays: Breathtaking, indoor-safe “cold spark” fountains for grand entrances and award ceremonies.

  • Custom Event Props: From LED batons and blow-up guitars to themed hats and “Blues Brothers” accessories.

Specialty Lighting & Custom Branding

Our Special Lighting design creates an immersive atmosphere tailored to your brand:

  • LED Wireless Uplighting: Wireless Remote Controlled, cable-free color washes.

  • Custom Gobo Design: Project your company logo or event theme onto floors and walls for a high-end, branded feel.

  • Motivational Lighting: Dynamic sequences for Annual Dinners And Product Launches.

Elite Bay Area Corporate DJ:
DJ Chris (The British DJ)

Need a Silicon Valley Stress Buster? DJ Chris, the premier SF Bay Area British DJ, is the expert at helping stressed-out CEOs and teams “let their hair down” for a jolly good time. Whether it’s a high-energy Company Holiday Party or a post-meeting Employee Appreciation event, we bring the music that gets everyone on the dance floor.

Elite Entertainment for Every Milestone

  • Company Holiday Parties: From “I Will Survive” and “The Hustle” to rocking out with the Beastie Boys, we play your requests!

  • Employee & Client Appreciation: Show your gratitude to clients & customers or staff with a high-impact “Sing Along” after your next big meeting.

  • Retirement Parties: Celebrate the legend “who’s been there forever” with everything from a classic Waltz or Swing to a modern Breakdance session.

  • Themed Fun: Dust off the Fancy Dress (costumes) or funny hats—we provide the perfect soundtrack to match your theme.

Why Book DJ Chris?

We guarantee a blast for your coworkers and employees. It’s time to bust out the dancing shoes and turn your corporate gathering into a legendary event. Based in San Francisco and serving all of Northern California, we are the #1 choice for firms that want a professional touch with a fun, international flair.

Click Here to Contact the Bay Area’s Best Corporate DJ





Top-Rated Bay Area Corporate DJ & Event Entertainment

Elevate your next brand experience with Chris Webb Entertainment, the premier choice for professional Bay Area corporate DJ services. Based in San Francisco, we provide award-winning DJs and MCs for companies across Northern California. From high-stakes business meetings to high-energy holiday parties, our team of professionals guarantees to please both you and the CEO.

Comprehensive Corporate Event Planning

Planning a company picnic, retirement, or grand opening? You’ve come to the right place. We handle the details in advance with a personal touch and continued interaction throughout the booking process. Our goal is to ensure your event turns out better than expected, leaving your guests clamoring for an encore!

Expert DJ & MC Services for Every Occasion

We offer professional Corporate DJs and MCs for a massive range of events and services, including:

Corporate & Gala Social & Themed Outdoor & Special
Annual Dinners Casino Nights Company Picnics & BBQs
Appreciation Nights Hollywood & Masquerade Beach Parties & Luaus
Team Building Conferences Pirate & Western Nights Boat Cruises
Trade Shows & Conventions Fashion Shows Golf Tournaments
Sales Boosters & Promotions Karaoke Contests (KJ) Car Shows & Poker Runs
Presentations & Audio Visual Elvis Tribute Shows Charity & Church Events

Also serving: Book Signings, City Events, Fairgrounds, House Parties, Luncheons, Night Clubs, and more.

Interactive Entertainment & Group Dances

Our Corporate Company Party DJ sets include motivational shows and high-energy group participation. Whether you want a “classic” vibe or a modern party, we offer a massive selection of group dances:

  • The Classics: YMCA, The Electric Slide, Macarena, The Hustle, and The Stroll.

  • Party Favorites: Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, The Chicken Dance, and The Conga Line.

  • Modern Hits: Gangnam Style, Harlem Shake, and The Mannequin Challenge.

  • Contests: Break Dance Contests, Karaoke, and the Dance Off.

  • Note: Whether “cheesy” or not, we play these strictly at your choice!

Party Favors, Props & Atmosphere

Add an extra layer of fun to your office parties or trade show events. We can provide a wide variety of props and favors to match your theme:

  • Tropical Themes: Coconut Bikinis, Hula Skirts, Maracas, and Beach Hats.

  • Party Props: Blow-up Guitars and Saxophones, Blues Brothers Hats, Sunglasses, and Wigs.

  • Grand Flair: Confetti Cannon Launchers, Mardi Gras Beads, and Glow-in-the-Dark items.

  • Interactive Gear: Limbo Poles, Hula-hoops, Conga Hats, and Western/Indian headpieces.

Premium Upgrades

Don’t forget to ask about our Photo Booth & Uplighting packages !

Ready to Book the Best Corporate Entertainment in San Francisco?

Whether it’s a Christmas party, a Texas Hold ‘Em night, or the Admiral’s Ball, Chris Webb Entertainment makes it easy for you to relax and enjoy yourself while we handle the fun.

Click Here to Contact Us Online Regarding Your Upcoming Corporate Event or Call Toll Free 415-350-5474 Send Your Corporate Event Timeline Here
